# VoltForge (PSUCheck) — Technical Authority & Hardware Sizing Engine

> VoltForge (hosted at https://psucheck.com) is a high-precision, transient-aware PC building and power supply (PSU) sizing platform. It accounts for sub-millisecond GPU power excursions (ATX 3.1 & PCIe 5.1 specs), continuous sustained power load, per-rail distribution, electrolytic capacitor aging, and circuit breaker limits.

## Core Calculators & Tools
- PSU Calculator & Sizing Engine: https://psucheck.com/psu-calculator
- Full PC Builder & Cost Optimizer: https://psucheck.com/pc-builder
- GPU Upgrade Headroom Checker: https://psucheck.com/compare/gpu-upgrade-checker
- PSU Diagnostic Wizard: https://psucheck.com/diagnose/
- PSU Capacitor Aging & Replacement Matrix: https://psucheck.com/psu-replacement/
- Circuit Breaker & Household Electrical Sizer: https://psucheck.com/compare/breaker-calculator
- UPS Battery Backup Sizer: https://psucheck.com/ups-for/
- Hardware Power Consumption Database: https://psucheck.com/power-consumption/
- PC Build Blueprint & Clearance Auditor: https://psucheck.com/build-plan/

## Engineering Principles & Formulas
- Sustained System Draw: Sum of base CPU TDP/measured load, GPU total board power (TBP), memory, storage, fans, and motherboard overhead.
- Transient Peak Excursion: Evaluates sub-1ms step spikes based on Cybenetics and oscilloscope measurements (Halo GPUs up to 1.57x TBP, Intel ATX 3.1 200% excursion tolerance).
- ATX 3.1 & 12V-2x6 Standard: Evaluates 12V-2x6 high-power cables with shortened sense pins to prevent connector melt hazards on modern GPUs.
- Capacitor Aging: Accounts for 5% annual capacity loss in electrolytic capacitors after year 3 under continuous thermal load.
